name: Kuddle Super Meal Garlic Paprika – Ready to Eat High Protein Meal | 16g Protein | No Preservatives | Free From Vegetable Oil | 225g
description: Kuddle Super Meal Garlic Paprika is a ready-to-eat, high-protein meal made with herbs-infused paneer, mushrooms, beans, vegetables, and a delicious garlic paprika seasoning. Enjoy a wholesome, nutritious meal anytime with no preservatives and no vegetable oil.
ingredients: Herbs Infused Paneer (Milk, Common Salt, Red Capsicum, Fresh Garlic, Green Chilli, Lemon Juice, Paprika), Mushroom, Garbanzo Beans, Kidney Beans, Black Chickpeas, Corn, Vegetable Broth (Water, Onion, Fresh Garlic, Bay Leaf, Fresh Thyme, Dry Thyme, Dry Basil, Salt, Lemon Juice), Moringa, Cabbage, French Beans, Celery, Spinach, Red Capsicum, Green Capsicum, Carrot, Rock Salt, Fresh Garlic, Fresh Sweet Corn, Paprika, Ginger.
